contents.name: Galerkin orthogonality for conforming Galerkin spaces

contents.reason: The source gives the orthogonality, coercivity, boundedness proof route and the M/alpha factor; the local proof includes existence and uniqueness and writes every inequality.

contents.name: Best approximation in the Hermitian energy norm
contents.reason: The source's Hermitian branch is restated and proved by the energy Pythagorean identity, with the complex conjugate symmetry explicit.

contents.name: Discrete solvability, Galerkin orthogonality and Céa's lemma
contents.reason: The real bilinear proof is read in full; the local theorem independently includes the finite-dimensional Hilbert argument and states its complex sesquilinear convention.

contents.name: Adjoint variational problem and L² Aubin–Nitsche argument
contents.reason: The complete duality argument is read; its Poisson/H² branch is not extended to arbitrary Lipschitz domains, and the local theorem states the precise dual approximation inputs.

contents.name: Reference interpolation, Bramble–Hilbert and affine scaling
contents.reason: The notes give the same reference-cell ingredients; their global interpolation lemma leaves its proof as an exercise, so the local carrier proves the global sum and scaling argument in full from the current in-run suppliers.
